SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r2.claim: The wrongdoer both commits denial and turns away, then leaves faith and prayer undone; the two kinds of failure provoke reproach for wrongful action and neglected good.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r2.anchor: والنفس هنا قدّمت التكذيب والتولّي: {ولاكن كَذَّبَ وتولى} وأخَّرت التصديقَ والصلاة {فَلاَ صَدَّقَ وَلاَ صلى}

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r3.claim: The person puts desires and sins first, connecting denial and turning away with the earlier account of wanting to continue sinning.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p224/r3.anchor: ذلك أنه كذّب وتولى، فقدم شهواته ومعاصيه

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r1.claim: Not believing in the Resurrection explains the person's failure to believe and pray; this links the conduct to his earlier question about when the Hour will come.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r1.anchor: فهو مستبعد له مكذب به فهو لم يصدق ولم يصل

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r2.claim: The deeds reported as sent ahead and left behind are disbelief and turning away on one side, and delayed faith and prayer on the other.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r2.anchor: فإنه قدم التكذيب والتولي وأخر التصديق والصلاة

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r3.claim: Faith is inward assent, while belief and denial are matters of the heart, speech, and limbs: he lacked inward belief, openly denied, and turned away from action, so he lacked faith's reality.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r3.anchor: فهو لم يصدّق بالجنان {فَلاَ صَدَّقَ} وكذّب باللسان، كما قال تعالى: {ولاكن كَذَّبَ}

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r4.claim: Failure to pray and turning away connect with the later attempt to offer excuses when questioned about those deeds.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r4.anchor: وارتبط عدم الصلاة والتولي بإلقاء المعاذير

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r5.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r5.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r5.claim: His denial also links to the question about gathering bones, since belief in the Last Day is a central article of faith.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r5.anchor: والإيمان باليوم الآخر من أهم أركان الإيمان

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r6.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r6.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r6.claim: The person loves the immediate life and leaves the afterlife, which accounts for his denial and turning away.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r7.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r7.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r7.claim: Had he believed and prayed, he would have joined the radiant faces; because he denied and turned away, he belongs with the grim-faced people.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p225/r7.anchor: لو صدق وصلى لكان من أصحاب الوجوه الناضرة

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r4.claim: It affirms two sins: denial and turning away.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r4.anchor: وأثبتت اثنتين من المعاصي وذلك في قوله: {ولاكن كَذَّبَ وتولى}

RAZI-FULL:v30p205#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p205#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p205#3/r1.claim: The passage describes denial of the fundamentals of faith, abandonment of prayer, and a swaggering return to family; the unbeliever merits blame and punishment for leaving prayer as for unbelief.
RAZI-FULL:v30p205#3/r1.anchor: أنه تعالى شرح كيفية عمله فيما يتعلق بأصول الدين وبفروعه ، وفيما يتعلق بدنياه

STUDYQURAN:75:31/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r1.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r1.claim: The person who neither confirmed nor prayed may be Abū Jahl.
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r1.anchor: He refers to Abū Jahl or ʿAdī ibn Rabīʿah

STUDYQURAN:75:31/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r2.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r2.claim: Alternatively, the person may be ʿAdī ibn Rabīʿah.
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r2.anchor: He refers to Abū Jahl or ʿAdī ibn Rabīʿah

STUDYQURAN:75:31/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r3.claim: The person did not affirm the Quran’s revelation or Muhammad’s prophethood.
STUDYQURAN:75:31/r3.anchor: He did not confirm the revelation and the prophethood of Muhammad

TAB-FULL:v23p522/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p522/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p522/r2.claim: Instead, he denied God’s Book and turned away from obedience to God.
TAB-FULL:v23p522/r2.anchor: {ولكن كذب وتولى} [القيامة: 32] كذب بكتاب الله، وتولى عن طاعة الله

TAB-FULL:v23p522/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p522/r3.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p522/r3.claim: Qatāda glosses the first phrase as not believing in God’s Book or praying to God, and the next as denying the Book and turning from obedience.
TAB-FULL:v23p522/r3.anchor: عن قتادة، {فلا صدق ولا صلى} [القيامة: 31] لا صدق بكتاب الله

TABATABAI:75:31-36/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:31-36/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:75:31-36/r1.claim: The pronouns refer to the human mentioned earlier; denied belief means affirming the Qur’an’s true call, and denied prayer is worship through salat, religion’s central pillar.
TABATABAI:75:31-36/r1.anchor: الضمائر راجعة إلى الإنسان المذكور في قوله { أيحسب الإنسان } الخ

TABATABAI:75:31-36/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:31-36/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:75:31-36/r2.claim: The man rejects the Qur’an’s beliefs and does not pray; instead he denies the call and turns away.
TABATABAI:75:31-36/r2.anchor: فلم يصدق هذا الانسان الدعوة فيما فيها من الاعتقاد ولم يصل لربه أي لم يتبعها فيما فيها من الفروع وركنها الصلاة

TABRISI:75:29-36/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:75:29-36/r11.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:75:29-36/r11.claim: Qatāda says he did not affirm God's Book or pray to God; instead he rejected the Book and Messenger and turned away from faith.
TABRISI:75:29-36/r11.anchor: لم يصدق بكتاب الله ولا صلى لله ولكن كذب بالكتاب والرسول وأعرض عن الإيمان عن قتادة

BURSEVI:v10p197/r16.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p197/r16.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p197/r16.claim: He rejected what had been conveyed about the Messenger and the Qurʾān.

BURSEVI:v10p197/r17.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p197/r17.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p197/r17.claim: ولكن prevents an inference that failure to affirm necessarily means outright denial: doubt lies between belief and denial, so this clause adds a distinct fact rather than repeating the previous one.
BURSEVI:v10p197/r17.anchor: والاستدراك لدفع احتمال الشك فإن نفي التصديق لا يستلزم إثبات التكذب

BURSEVI:v10p197/r18.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p197/r18.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p197/r18.claim: He turned away from obedience and from the Messenger.
BURSEVI:v10p197/r18.anchor: {وتولى} واعرض عن الطاعةولرسوله {ثم ذهب إلى أهله}

THALABI:v10p90/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p90/r7.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p90/r7.claim: Abu Jahl instead rejected the message and turned away.
THALABI:v10p90/r7.anchor: ولكن كذب وتولى ثم ذهب إلى أهله يتمطى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p525/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p525/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p525/r1.claim: He denied the Qur’an, turned away from faith, and returned to his family.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p525/r1.anchor: قوله: {ولكن كذب}، أي: بالقرآن. {وتولى} عن الإيمان.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r3.claim: He denied the message and turned away from faith.

ELMALILI:75:31-35/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r3.claim: Elmalılı favors the almsgiving sense because otherwise v32 merely reinforces the denial; ṣaddaqa can mean almsgiving, matching al-Muddaththir 74:43–44.
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r3.anchor: Evvelkinde وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ mücerred tekid gibi kalmış olacağından bu mâna daha faydalıdır.

ELMALILI:75:31-35/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r4.claim: The fā links these clauses to the preceding account of the sinner absorbed in worldly pleasure, who asks when the Resurrection will come, and frames his eventual return to God.
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r4.anchor: İkisinde de bunun “fâ” ile yukarıya rabtı şu mazmûnu ifade eyler

ELMALILI:75:31-35/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r5.claim: The sinner neither affirmed the hereafter nor did work for God, gave no alms or prayer, denied God, the Messenger, Qur’an, and afterlife, and turned away from truth and obedience.
ELMALILI:75:31-35/r5.anchor: Çünkü o dünyada ilerisini ne tasdik etti, ne Allah için bir amel işledi, ne sadaka verdi, ne namaz kıldı

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r1.claim: The passage criticizes disbelievers who still refuse the truth, Qur’an, and Prophet and avoid worship despite extensive proofs of God’s unity, resurrection, and the punishment awaiting deniers.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r1.anchor: hâlâ gerçeği kabul etmemekte, Kur’an’ı ve peygamberi tasdik etmemekte direnen, Allah’a kulluğunu arzetmekten kaçınan inkârcı tutum

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r2.claim: The unbeliever refuses revelation and worship and deliberately lies about the truth and its messenger.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r2.anchor: O inkârcı tip, vahyi onaylamaya, Allah’a kulluk etmeye yanaşmaz; hakkı, hak davetçisini inatla yalanlamaya kalkışır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r3.claim: Instead of listening and judging fairly, he turns away with blind bigotry, shuts his ears, and locks his heart.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r3.anchor: ilgi gösterip kulağını ve zihnini söylenenlere açacağı, insafla değerlendireceği yerde, kör bir taassupla gerçeğe sırtını döner, kulağını tıkar, kalbini kilitler.

SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r1.claim: لكن corrects the inference: failing to give and pray does not entail denial and turning away, since many Muslims do likewise; here it explains failure as rooted in rejection and aversion.
SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r1.anchor: لا يلزم من نفي التصدق والصلاة التكذيب والتولي؛ لأن كثيرا من المسلمين كذلك، فاستدرك ذلك: بأن سببه

SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r2.claim: It is weak to interpret the first denial as rejecting the Messenger, since that repeats كذب and puts لكن between equivalent statements.
SAMIN-DURR:75:32/r2.anchor: ولهذا يضعف أن يحمل نفي التصديق على نفي تصديق الرسول؛ لئلا يلزم التكرار

ASAD-NOTES:75:31/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:75:31/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:75:31/r2.claim: Instead, he denied the truth and turned away from it.
ASAD-NOTES:75:31/r2.anchor: he gave the lie to the truth

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p229/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p229/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p229/r3.claim: The Qiyāma figure is worse: unlike the possibly outwardly believing and praying people in Muhammad, he openly denies, turns away, then struts, so he deserves a stronger threat.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p229/r3.anchor: وربما أظهر الأول التصديق والصلاة في حين أن الثاني أظهر التكذيب والتولي، ثم ذهب إلى أهله متبختراً بذاك

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r1.claim: Each of the two faults first receives a warning; the second verse restates them as denial and turning away, so the author counts four warnings, one for each fault in both formulations.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r1.anchor: فلا صدق ... أولى لك. ولا صلى ... فأولى

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r4.claim: Denial rejects faith at its foundation—the Messenger and the other pillars of faith—whereas neglect of prayer is a distinct and lesser failure.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p230/r4.anchor: وعدم التصديق أو التكذيب هو إنكار للإيمان من أساسه، فهو لم يصدق بالرسالة ولا ببقية أركان الإيمان

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p231/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p231/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p231/r3.claim: The restatement is harsher: explicit public denial is worse than simply not affirming, and turning away is broader and worse than merely not praying, so the second verse intensifies the first.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p231/r3.anchor: فإنه قال أولاً: {فَلاَ صَدَّقَ} وقال في التأكيد والإعادة: {ولاكن كَذَّبَ} والتكذيب إنما يكون بالإعلان والإشهار

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p232/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p232/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p232/r1.claim: Thumma can mark distance in rank, not only time: the Qur'anic example in 90:11–17 distinguishes freeing and feeding from faith, so the later threat is more forceful.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p232/r1.anchor: فما بعد (ثم) أبعد من الرتبة مما قبلها، وكذلك ههنا فإن التهديد أقوى من الأول

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r1.claim: The condemned are exposed to fire in the grave morning and evening, then face a more severe punishment after the Resurrection.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r1.anchor: فهم يعرضون على النار غدواً وعشياً في القبر، ويوم تقوم الساعة لهم عذابٌ أشد.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r2.claim: ثم marks the interval between the two punishments and the distance between them in time and severity.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r2.anchor: وجاء بينهما بـ (ثم) الدالة على المهلة والتراخي. والدالة على بُعْدِ ما بين التهديدين والعذابين في الشدة.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r8.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r8.speaker: فتح القدير
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r8.claim: Al-Fath al-Qadir reports that repeating أولى لك فأولى four times means woe to the person while alive; the excerpt cuts off before the explanation is complete.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p233/r8.anchor: في (فتح القدير) في قوله: {أولى لَكَ فأولى * ثُمَّ أولى لَكَ فأولى}

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p684/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p684/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p684/r4.claim: The later “denied and turned away” restates the lack of belief and prayer; each is reinforced and receives its own warning, yielding four threats.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p684/r4.anchor: وجاء (كذّب) مقابل (لا صدّق) و (تولّى) مقابل (لا صلّى)

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p63/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p63/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p63/r5.claim: When reminded of these duties, he responds with arrogance and walks away conceitedly to his family.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p63/r5.anchor: he would be reminded of these duties, he would express utter arrogance

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p82/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p82/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p82/r1.claim: The disbelievers face an exacting journey without provisions: they neither prayed nor spent in God’s way, the two deeds that would benefit them.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p82/r1.anchor: no resources and provisions to take along.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r3.claim: The verbs contrast: they should have affirmed the Messenger and Hereafter, spent, and prayed, but instead denied the Hereafter and turned away.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r3.anchor: however, they belied the Hereafter and became indifferent.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r4.claim: Prayer and spending in God’s way are the two primary deeds on which the sharīʿah is based, and both depend on firm belief in the Hereafter.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p83/r4.anchor: prayer and spending in the way of God

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p352/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p352/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p352/r10.claim: He turned away from the Messenger and rejected what the Messenger brought.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p352/r10.anchor: وتولى: أعرض عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وكذب بما جاء به

ALUSI-FULL:v29p148#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p148#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p148#3/r1.claim: The follow-up rules out an imagined silence or hesitation: he actively displayed denial and turned away from obedience.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p148#3/r1.anchor: نفي التوهم السكو أو الشك أي ومع ذلك أظهرالجحود والتوليعن الطاعة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p286/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p286/r12.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p286/r12.claim: He denied the truth and turned away from faith.

BAYDAWI-FULL:75:32-36/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:75:32-36/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:75:32-36/r1.claim: He denied the truth and turned away from obedience.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p253#2/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p253#2/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p253#2/r13.claim: Instead he actively denied God’s message and turned away from prayer and obedience, persisting until his original sound nature died and his commanding self prevailed; this is not redundant because lack of affirmation is not itself denial.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p253#2/r13.anchor: وليس هذا بتكرار لأنه لا يلزم من عدم التصديق التكذيب

DURR-FULL:v8p362/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p362/r6.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p362/r6.claim: Qatadah identifies the denier as Abu Jahl: he did not affirm God’s Book or pray, rejected it, turned from obedience, and went home swaggering.
DURR-FULL:v8p362/r6.anchor: عن قتادة رضي الله عنه في قوله: {فلا صدق}

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r1.claim: ولكن كذب is coordinated with فلا صدق. The ungeminated لكن is an inceptive conjunction, not the sister of إن that takes effect on case; it commonly follows a conjunction wāw.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r1.anchor: وحرف { لكن } المخفف لا يعمل إعرابا فهو حرف ابتداء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r2.claim: لكن can reinforce by stating the contrary, as in 33:5, or clarify an earlier general negation, as in 33:40.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r2.anchor: إما لمجرد توكيد المعنى بذكر نقيضه مثل قوله تعالى : { وليس عليكم جناح فيما أخطأتم به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r4.claim: His denial concerns resurrection, the Quran, and Muhammad’s message.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r4.anchor: والتكذيب : تكذيبه بالبعث وبالقرآن وبرسالة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r5.claim: Turning away means rejecting the invitation to examine and reflect on the Quran.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p362/r5.anchor: والتولي : الإعراض عن دعوته إلى النظر والتدبر في القرآن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p406#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p406#2/r1.speaker: جمهور المتأولين
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p406#2/r1.claim: Most interpreters say the entire passage concerns Abu Jahl ibn Hisham.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p406#2/r1.anchor: قال جمهور المتأولين: هذه الآية كلها إنما نزلت في أبي جهل بن هشام

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p425#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p425#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p425#3/r1.claim: He rejected the truth and turned away from faith.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p282#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p282#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p282#2/r2.claim: The condemned unbeliever denied truth inwardly and turned away from righteous action outwardly, with no good in either his inner or outward state.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p282#2/r2.anchor: الكافر الذي كان في الدار الدنيا مكذبا للحق بقلبه، متوليا عن العمل بقالبه،

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p664#2/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p664#2/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p664#2/r7.claim: The man disbelieved in the Messenger, turned away, then returned to his people strutting proudly.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p664#2/r7.anchor: ثم ذهب إلى قومه يتبختر افتخارا بذلك

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p157/r21.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p157/r21.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p157/r21.claim: One reading is that he called the Messenger a liar and turned away from the One who sent him.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p157/r22.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p157/r22.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p157/r22.claim: Another reading is that he rejected the Quran and turned away from obedience.

MUQATIL:75:22-33/r11.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:75:22-33/r11.speaker: author
MUQATIL:75:22-33/r11.claim: He denied the Qur'an and turned away from faith.
MUQATIL:75:22-33/r11.anchor: { ولكن كذب وتولى } [آية: 32] يقول: ولكن كذب بالقرآن وتولى عن الإيمان يقول: أعرض عن الإيمان

NASAFI-FULL:v4p301#9/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p301#9/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p301#9/r1.claim: He denied the Qur'an and turned away from faith.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p301#9/r1.anchor: بالقرآن ﴿ وتولى ﴾ عن الإيمان أو فلا صدق ما له

QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r1.claim: The man denied the Qur’an and turned away from faith.
QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r1.anchor: أي كذب بالقرآن وتولى عن الإيمان

QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r8.claim: The four faults are failure to believe the Messenger, failure to pray before God, denial, and turning away from prayer; strutting predated denial.
QURTUBI-FULL:75:32-35/r8.anchor: فترك التصديق خصلة، والتكذيب خصلة، وترك الصلاة خصلة، والتولي عن الله تعالى خصلة
